en.topic_title: New Zealand judge Terence Arnold appointed to Hong Kong’s Court of Final Appeal
en.topic_summary:
A new overseas non-permanent judge has been appointed to Hong Kong’s Court of Final Appeal (CFA) following a spate of resignations – and subsequent criticism from some former jurists – since the introduction of national security legislation.
